name: Meta Ads (Marketing API)
summary: Your Facebook and Instagram ad accounts: account details, campaigns, and performance insights (spend, reach, clicks, conversions) at any level and breakdown.

api_version.description: Graph API version. Meta retires old versions after about two years; pin one only to stay on it deliberately.

token.description: a long-lived access token with the ads_read permission (a system-user token from Meta Business Settings > System users, or a user token from a Meta app)

notes: Own-account API: reaches ad accounts the token's user or system user was given access to.
Ad account ids carry the act_ prefix in paths. Insights money fields (spend) come back as strings in the account currency, not cents.
Pagination is cursor style: the answer's paging.next URL, or paging.cursors.after passed back as after.
This catalog covers reads only; creating or changing campaigns is not included.

endpoints.name: Get an ad account
endpoints.summary: Name, currency, status, timezone and amount spent of one ad account.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id WITH the act_ prefix.

notes: account_status is numeric: 1 active, 2 disabled, 3 unsettled.

endpoints.name: List an ad account's campaigns
endpoints.summary: Campaigns with the fields you ask for.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id WITH the act_ prefix.

effective_status.description: Filter by status: ACTIVE, PAUSED, ARCHIVED, DELETED.

date_preset.description: Date range for any insights fields requested, e.g. last_7d.

notes: With no effective_status filter, archived and deleted campaigns are left out.

endpoints.name: Get ad performance insights
endpoints.summary: Spend, impressions, clicks, conversions and more for an account, campaign, ad set or ad, by day or breakdown.

ad_account_id.description: Ad account id WITH the act_ prefix.

fields.description: Comma-separated metrics, e.g. impressions,spend,clicks,ctr,actions. Default is impressions and spend.

level.description: Roll rows up at this level.

date_preset.description: Relative range, e.g. last_7d, last_30d (default), this_month, maximum. Ignored when time_range is set.

time_increment.description: all_days (default), monthly, or 1-90 for N-day buckets.

breakdowns.description: Split rows by age, gender, country, region, publisher_platform...; only some combinations are allowed.

filtering.description: [{field, operator, value}] filters; operators include EQUAL, IN, GREATER_THAN, CONTAIN.

notes: Large queries can time out; narrow the date range or level, or request fewer breakdowns.
Conversions appear under actions as {action_type, value} lists, not as flat fields.
